form.heading: Warranty Claim
form.intro: Use this form to report a suspected manufacturing defect covered by CaratForUs's 1-year limited manufacturing warranty. The warranty covers defects in materials, construction, setting, or assembly under normal use. Examples may include defective solder joints, structural workmanship failures, setting defects, and defective clasps or mechanisms under normal use. It does not cover normal wear, scratches, dents, impact damage, worn or bent prongs, stone loss caused by damage or wear, misuse, improper care, sizing changes, or unauthorized repairs, alterations, or modifications.
form.notice_heading: Please don't send your item yet
form.notice_body: Do not send your jewelry until CaratForUs authorizes an inspection and provides shipping instructions.
form.sign_in_required_message: Please sign in or create a CaratForUs account to continue.
form.order_number_help: Enter the number for the order that includes the item this claim is about.
form.order_lookup_not_found: We couldn't find that order on your account. Please check the order number and try again, or contact us for help.
form.select_item_legend: Which item is this claim about?
form.cant_find_order_help: Can't find your order? Contact us and we'll help you complete this form.
form.item_configuration_placeholder: Describe the exact item and configuration, e.g. ring style, metal, size
form.issue_first_noticed_date_label: Date you first noticed the issue (optional)
form.impact_question_label: Has this item experienced an impact, accident, unusual force, or other damage event?
form.altered_question_label: Has this item been resized, repaired, altered, serviced, or modified by anyone since delivery?
form.uploads_note: Photo uploads aren’t available right now. Please describe the issue below, and mention that you have photos — we’ll ask for them if an inspection is authorized.
form.acknowledgment_text: I certify that the information and files I submitted are accurate to the best of my knowledge. I understand that submitting this claim does not establish warranty coverage. I will not send my jewelry until CaratForUs authorizes an inspection and provides shipping instructions. If inspection is authorized, I am responsible for tracked and appropriately insured shipping to CaratForUs. Coverage and any remedy will be determined after CaratForUs reviews the claim and, when applicable, inspects the item.
form.error_order_id_required: Find and select your order above.
form.error_line_item_id_required: Select which item this claim is about.
form.error_acknowledgment_required: You must certify and agree before submitting.
form.error_order_not_found: We couldn't verify that order and item. Please search for your order again, or contact us for help.
form.error_service_unavailable: We couldn't submit your claim right now. Please try again shortly.
form.error_network: We couldn't reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.
form.success_body_html: Thank you. Your warranty claim reference is {{ reference }}. Submitting this claim does not mean your item is covered under the warranty. Please don't send your item to us — we will contact you if we need more information, and before authorizing your item for inspection.
form.uploads_help: Add up to 5 photos, 20 MB each. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC. Clear, well-lit close-ups of the problem area help most.
form.error_upload_too_many: You can add up to 5 photos.
form.error_upload_too_large: That file is larger than 20 MB. Please choose a smaller photo.
form.error_upload_type: That file type isn’t supported. Please choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.
form.error_upload_failed: That photo could not be uploaded. You can try again, or submit your claim without it and mention the issue in your description.

form.heading: Custom jewelry request
form.intro: Tell us what you have in mind and we'll design it with you.
form.deposit_disclosure: This enquiry is free. If we move forward with design/CAD work, there is a $49 Design Deposit. The deposit is charged when design/CAD work begins and is credited toward your final price. If CaratForUs completes the agreed design stage and you decide not to proceed, the $49 deposit is refunded.
form.confirmation_template: Thanks — we’ve received your custom jewelry request and recorded it under {projectReference}. There’s no charge for this enquiry. We’ll be in touch by email.

form.budget_help: In US dollars. An approximate figure is fine.
form.inspiration_help: Reference images help a lot. Paste links, or attach photos if you're signed in.

Because of that, this item can’t be returned or exchanged if you change your mind, prefer another style, or choose the wrong size or configuration. Please review the specifications and your selected options carefully before ordering.
disclosure.claims: This does not affect claims for an item that arrives damaged, is not what you ordered, does not match its description, or may have a manufacturing issue covered by our warranty. If something is wrong with your order, contact us and we’ll review it under the applicable CaratForUs warranty or claims policy.
